import cyclopts

# Create CLI app with configuration from pyproject.toml [tool.mycli] section
app = cyclopts.App(
    config=cyclopts.Config(
        sources=[
            cyclopts.sources.TomlConfigSource(
                path="pyproject.toml",
                section="tool.mycli",
            )
        ]
    )
)


@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hello",
    count: int = 1,
) -> None:
    """Greeting CLI with configuration from pyproject.toml.

    Command-line arguments override values from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml.

    Example pyproject.toml:
        [tool.mycli]
        name = "Alice"
        greeting = "Hi"
        count = 3

    Args:
        name: Name to greet
        greeting: Greeting prefix
        count: Number of times to greet
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        print(f"{greeting}, {name}!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
